Corollary
[Higher-order Sobolev embeddings] 1. ch7:7.11\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0170 There are continuous embeddings \[ W_0^{k,p}(\Omega )\hookrightarrow \begin{cases} L^{np/(n-kp)}(\Omega ),& kp<n,\\ C^m(\overline\Omega ),& 0\leq m<k-n/p. \end{cases} \] On $W_0^{k,p}(\Omega )$, an equivalent norm is \begin{equation} \tag {7.29} \| u\| _{W_0^{k,p}(\Omega )} =\left(\int _\Omega \sum _{|\alpha |=k}|D^\alpha u|^p\, dx\right)^{1/p}. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Iterate Theorem 7.10 through derivatives of orders below $k$. The same inequalities control all lower-order terms by the top-order expression in (7.29).

□
